name: Badami Cave Temples Accessibility Profile
location: Badami Cave Complex, Badami, Bagalkote District

stairs_details.step_character: Uneven red sandstone carved steps with varying rise and run; metal handrails installed along primary flight between Cave 1 and Cave 2; steep open flights to Cave 3 and Cave 4
stairs_details.handrails: Present along primary staircase flights, absent in some rock-cut landing zones

terrain: Solid sandstone rock slope, stone stairs, uneven stone landings
accessible_entrances: Level entrance plaza up to the ASI ticket gate and garden; caves themselves are accessible only via stairs
rest_areas: Stone and wooden benches installed in the landscaped garden near the entrance; shaded rock niches at cave verandas

toilets.accessible: Semi-accessible toilet block at entrance plaza; no toilets on upper cave tiers

parking.type: Designated vehicle parking outside outer security perimeter
parking.distance_to_entrance: Approx. 150m walk on flat paved street

transport: Auto-rickshaws, taxis, and town buses reach within 150m of entrance
medical_facilities: First-aid kit available at ASI ticket counter; Taluk General Hospital Badami is 2 km away
accessibility_facilities: Tactile pathways: Not available; Wheelchair loan: Available for garden area only; Braille signage: Partial ASI Braille inscription plaque at entrance
source: Archaeological Survey of India & Field Assessment Guidelines

name: Pattadakal UNESCO Monument Complex Accessibility Profile

stairs_details.step_character: Low stone plinth steps (2 to 5 steps) to enter temple mandapas; ground pathways around monuments are level

terrain: Smooth stone-paved walkways, manicured flat lawns, low stone thresholds
accessible_entrances: Dedicated ramp provided at the main ASI entrance gate and ticket office
rest_areas: Numerous park benches placed under mature shade trees across the lawns

toilets.accessible: Dedicated wheelchair-accessible toilet cubicle in the modern ASI sanitation block

parking.type: Spacious paved parking ground with dedicated accessible parking spots close to ticket gate

transport: Tour buses and private vehicles can drop passengers directly at the ticketing plaza
medical_facilities: First-aid station at ASI administrative office; Badami General Hospital 22 km away
accessibility_facilities: Wheelchair available on request at ticket counter; smooth paved perimeter pathway connects all 10 major temples
source: UNESCO World Heritage Centre & Archaeological Survey of India

name: Aihole Durga Temple & Museum Complex Accessibility Profile
walking_requirements: Moderate (Main complex is compact; other temples in village require road walking)

stairs_details.step_character: Main complex grounds are flat; temple plinths have 4 to 8 stone steps
stairs_details.handrails: Ramps with handrails into the ASI Archaeological Museum

terrain: Stone-flagged pathways, packed earthen paths, grass lawns
accessible_entrances: Main entrance gate has level flagstone access; ASI museum has ramp access
rest_areas: Garden benches available in the Durga temple enclosure

toilets.accessible: Clean toilet block on campus with basic grab bars

parking.type: Paved parking area opposite Durga temple main gate

transport: Buses and taxis drop directly outside entrance gate
medical_facilities: Primary Health Centre (PHC) Aihole within 1 km
accessibility_facilities: Wheelchair available at ASI ticket desk for museum and garden pathways
source: Archaeological Survey of India & Karnataka Tourism

name: Kudala Sangama Pilgrim Complex Accessibility Profile
location: Kudala Sangama, Hunagund Taluk, Bagalkote District
walking_requirements: Low to Moderate (Battery-operated buggy service available on campus)

stairs_details.step_character: Wide, gently sloping ramps bypass all primary staircases; subterranean passage to river Aikya Mantapa is equipped with elevator / ramp access
stairs_details.handrails: Continuous stainless-steel handrails on all ramps and staircases

terrain: Polished granite and concrete paved walkways, level riverfront promenades
accessible_entrances: Step-free ramped entrances to Sangameshwara Temple, Auditorium, Museum, and Dasoha Bhavan
rest_areas: Hundreds of covered resting gazebos, pergolas, and stone benches throughout the riverfront campus

toilets.accessible: Fully accessible modern disabled-friendly washrooms in multiple blocks
toilets.distance_from_monument: Within 50m of all major public facilities

parking.type: Vast paved parking with designated disabled priority parking bays

transport: Campus battery vehicles ferry seniors and persons with disabilities between parking and temples
medical_facilities: On-site 24x7 Government Primary Health Centre / Dispensary with ambulance
accessibility_facilities: Wheelchair fleet available free of cost; braille signage in museum; audio aids available

name: Almatti Dam Gardens Accessibility Profile

stairs_details.step_character: Garden terraces have low flights of steps complemented by wide concrete ramps
stairs_details.handrails: Installed along terraced pathways and musical fountain amphitheater

terrain: Smooth asphalt and concrete pathways suitable for prams and wheelchairs
accessible_entrances: Wide level entrance gates with ramped turnstiles
rest_areas: Generous garden seating, gazebos, and grassy lawns

toilets.accessible: Public sanitation blocks with ramp access

parking.type: Expansive parking lot with designated spots for disabled vehicles

transport: Electric sightseeing golf carts available during peak tourist hours
medical_facilities: First-aid room on site; Almatti Project Hospital within 2 km
accessibility_facilities: Wheelchair friendly promenade overlooking dam and musical fountain

name: Mahakuta Temple & Springs Accessibility Profile

stairs_details.step_character: Uneven ancient stone thresholds and steps; wet and mossy steps surrounding the Pushkarini spring pool

terrain: Ancient flagstone paving, tree root undulations, wet stone surfaces near water tank
rest_areas: Shaded stone platforms around banyan trees

toilets.accessible: Basic public toilets outside; NOT wheelchair accessible

parking.type: Unpaved dirt parking outside outer gateway

transport: Taxis and autos can drop at outer gateway
